label: rewrite keeps the old facts?
instructions: Is every part of the old memory in quoted_old that is still true after the messages in quoted_source kept in the new memory in quoted_new?
true: Yes: everything the old memory said that is still true is in the new one, though it may be worded differently or extended.
false: No: the new memory drops or blurs something from the old one that the messages didn't change.

true: "Kai quit coffee." → "Kai quit coffee last month; temple headaches when he cut back."
false: "Kai's sister Mia is a nurse in Ipoh." → "Kai's sister is a nurse."

state_note: memory D15: one request per rewrite; p >= t_keep supersedes, else the new line is inserted beside the old one. t_keep starts at 0.7 and is tuned in M13 (phase 10).
